en.headline: Two men injured after escalator fall at Shek Lei Shopping Centre
en.dek: A 76-year-old man lost his balance on a Phase 1 escalator on Sunday afternoon, colliding with a 68-year-old man behind him; both were taken to hospital conscious.
body: Police received a report at about 4.19 p.m. on Sunday that three people had fallen on an escalator at Shek Lei Shopping Centre Phase 1 in Kwai Chung. A 76-year-old man surnamed Sung was trapped and had to be freed by firefighters and paramedics.

The man sustained abrasions to his limbs and was taken conscious by ambulance to Princess Margaret Hospital. A 68-year-old man surnamed Poon suffered a hand abrasion and was also sent to the same hospital. A third person was unhurt.

The escalator, which links the mall to the underground market, was closed for safety checks. Police classified the case as a person injured in an accident. The same escalator was involved in a similar incident on 1 August that left four people hurt.

zh.headline: 石籬商場扶手電梯兩男跌倒受傷 七旬翁一度被困
zh.dek: 周日下午一名76歲男子在石籬商場一期扶手電梯失平衡向後跌，撞倒身後68歲男子，兩人清醒送瑪嘉烈醫院。
body: 警方下午約4時19分接報，指葵涌石籬商場一期有人在扶手電梯跌倒。一名76歲姓宋男子一度被困，消防及救護人員到場協助救出。
宋翁手腳擦傷，清醒由救護車送往瑪嘉烈醫院；68歲姓潘男子手部擦損，同樣送院。第三人無恙。警方將案件列作有人意外受傷。
涉事由商場通往地下街市的扶手電梯事後被封閉，待技工檢查確認安全後才重開。同月1日同一扶手電梯亦曾發生類似意外，造成四人受傷。
